dataset: OS Open Zoomstack — GeoPackage schema / local_buildings
data_date: Selected schema window does not expose a package build date; product publication months are June and December.
evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey OS Open Zoomstack official documentation defines the GeoPackage local_buildings layer as Polygon geometry. Its listed attributes are id (SERIAL PRIMARY KEY), uuid (varchar) and geom (Polygon), with no type, use, name or functional classification field on the local_buildings record. OS documentation describes OS Open Zoomstack as an OpenData product downloadable from the OS Data Hub, and OS OpenData download products are made available under the Open Government Licence. This source window therefore confirms an official physical building-polygon layer exists, but does not provide explicit type/use evidence bound to each footprint record.

field_evidence.footprint: Official OS Open Zoomstack GeoPackage schema declares local_buildings geometry type Polygon.
field_evidence.type_use: The same official local_buildings schema lists only id, uuid and geom; no explicit type/use/name attribute is present.
field_evidence.coverage: OS Open Zoomstack is an official Great Britain OpenData product; the selected source window is schema/source-area evidence and not an Exeter record payload.
field_evidence.license: OS OpenData download products are made available under the Open Government Licence.
